entry.title: 人生进阶指南｜AI 时代终身学习
entry.summary: 《人生进阶指南》帮助普通人在 AI 时代持续学习、完成真实项目、穿越人生低谷并留下成长证据。

entry.title: Life Level-up Guide | Lifelong Learning in the AI Era
entry.summary: Learning continuously in the AI era, Life Level-up Guide helps ordinary people complete real projects, move through difficult seasons, and preserve evidence of growth.

entry.title: Third-party Resources | Verify Before Use
entry.summary: Optional AI learning and tool links with review dates, public positioning, and a clear non-sponsorship boundary. Independently verify terms, privacy, pricing, copyright, and service status before use.

entry.title: English Diagnostic: Four-skill Baseline and Transfer Record
entry.summary: Preserve listening, reading, speaking, and writing first versions, conditions, errors, feedback, delayed retests, and CEFR direction without replacing ability evidence with averages or polished work.

entry.title: Learning Principles: Turn Effort into Verifiable Learning
entry.summary: Use real tasks, first-version baselines, retrieval, feedback, spacing, recovery, and cross-session state so effort becomes comparable and transferable evidence.

entry.title: Vocabulary: From Familiarity to Retrieval in Real Tasks
entry.summary: Begin with a first-encounter baseline and lookup decisions, verify sense and collocation, then build usable vocabulary through unaided retrieval, error repair, and delayed transfer.

entry.title: Listening: From Sound Recognition to Real Understanding
entry.summary: Begin with one uninterrupted first pass, locate language, segmentation, structure, background, and attention barriers, then use minimum transcript support, meaning reconstruction, output, and delayed transfer.

entry.title: Reading: From Word-by-word Translation to Claims and Evidence
entry.summary: Begin with a real reading task and first-pass baseline, then separate language, structure, background, layout, and attention barriers while training technical documentation, source comparison, evidence checks, and delivery.

entry.title: Speaking: Make Meaning Arrive
entry.summary: Begin with unscripted baselines, a reference variety, and real listeners to train comprehensibility, pronunciation, chunks, interaction repair, and transfer without treating accent removal as the goal.

entry.title: Writing: From Draft to Verifiable Revision
entry.summary: Begin with a real audience and unaided draft, then train intention, facts, structure, register, feedback uptake, translation boundaries, AI collaboration, asynchronous handover, and authorship responsibility.

entry.title: Grammar: Let Structure Serve Meaning
entry.summary: Begin from a real task and an unpolished sample, treat grammar as choices about time, participants, certainty, logic, and information focus, then build usable structure through contrast, output, feedback, delayed retest, and transfer.

entry.title: English Diagnostic | Find a Retestable Baseline
entry.summary: Start with one five-minute English baseline, then complete a four-skill diagnostic and fourteen-day retest when your goal calls for it.

entry.title: 第三方资源目录｜使用前独立核验
entry.summary: 汇总可选的 AI 学习与工具入口，记录链接复核时间、公开定位和非赞助边界；使用前请独立检查条款、隐私、价格、版权与服务状态。

entry.title: 英语能力诊断：四项基线与迁移记录
entry.summary: 在同一真实主题下保存听说读写首版、条件、错误、反馈、延迟复测与 CEFR 方向，避免用平均分或润色成品代替能力证据。

entry.title: 认知篇：把努力变成可验证的学习
entry.summary: 用真实任务、首版基线、主动回忆、反馈、间隔、恢复和跨会话状态，把努力变成可比较、可迁移的学习证据。

entry.title: 词汇篇：从眼熟到在真实任务中调用
entry.summary: 从首遇基线、查词决策、义项与搭配核验出发，用无提示调用、误用修复和延迟迁移建立真正可用的词汇系统。

entry.title: 听力篇：从声音辨认到真实理解
entry.summary: 从一次不暂停的首听开始，定位词汇、切分、结构、背景与注意力障碍，用最小字幕支架、意义重构、输出和延迟迁移把一段材料练成可用理解。

entry.title: 阅读篇：从逐词翻译到观点与证据
entry.summary: 从真实阅读任务和首读基线出发，拆分语言、结构、背景与注意力障碍，训练技术文档、多来源比较、证据核验与真实交付。

entry.title: 口语篇：让意思清楚到达
entry.summary: 从无稿基线、参考变体与真实听众出发，训练可理解度、发音、词块、互动修复和陌生问题迁移，不把消灭口音当成口语目标。

entry.title: 写作篇：从初稿到可验证修订
entry.summary: 从真实受众与无辅助初稿出发，训练意图、事实、结构、语域、反馈吸收、翻译边界、AI 协作、异步交接和署名责任。

entry.title: 语法篇：让结构服务于意思
entry.summary: 从真实任务与未经修饰的样本出发，把语法还原成时间、参与者、确定性、因果与信息重点的选择，并用对比、输出、反馈、延迟复测和迁移建立可用结构。

entry.title: 英语能力诊断｜找到可复测的起点
entry.summary: 面向想提升工作与日常英语的自学者，先用五分钟保存一项英语基线，再按需完成听说读写完整诊断，记录障碍并安排十四天后的平行任务复测。

entry.title: Entrepreneurship: From Ambition to Purpose
entry.summary: A personal review of products, cash flow, technical debt, failure, recovery, and starting again, without offering a success formula or investment advice.

entry.title: My Story: Failure, Recovery, and Starting Again
entry.summary: A personal account of business setbacks, entrepreneurial losses, disrupted health and life, and finding the courage to act again after returning home.

entry.title: 创业篇：从野心到使命
entry.summary: 一份关于产品、现金流、技术债、失败、恢复与再次创业的个人复盘，不提供成功学结论或投资建议。

entry.title: 我的故事：失败、恢复与重新出发
entry.summary: 一段关于事业起落、创业失利、身体与生活失序，以及回家恢复后重新找回行动勇气的个人记录。

entry.title: AI Evaluation Record
entry.summary: Record scope, held-out cases, versions, mandatory checks, failures, and complete process costs to decide whether to adopt, repair, or withdraw an AI workflow.

entry.title: AI Learning Log: From Tool Collaboration to Independent Ability
entry.summary: Record a real learning task, unaided baseline, tool scope, source checks, active production, delayed retest, transfer, and the next cycle decision.

entry.title: AI Task Brief: From Problem to Human Acceptance
entry.summary: Before an AI learning or project task, define the real action, data boundary, sources, evaluation set, human ownership, cost, failure handling, and handover.

entry.title: AI Trend Experiment: From Signal to Decision
entry.summary: Record a primary source, task hypothesis, manual baseline, held-out set, permissions, full cost, independent transfer, and exit conditions for one new AI capability.

entry.title: AI Learning, Project Development, and Resource-layer Entrepreneurship
entry.summary: Han Xiankai's path from learning with AI to building and operating an AI resource layer, with engineering, delivery, operations, and business results kept distinct.

entry.title: AI Trends and a Learning Roadmap: Turn Change into Ability
entry.summary: Use primary signals, reproducible experiments, and independent transfer to decide which AI capabilities are worth learning, covering agents, multimodal inputs, context, local models, evaluation, and provenance.

entry.title: AI Evaluation and Reliability — Knowing When to Deliver
entry.summary: Compare AI workflows using real tasks, small test sets, failure categories, and full process costs, and distinguish a successful demo from dependable use.

entry.title: AI 评测记录模板
entry.summary: 记录任务范围、保留样本、版本、硬性条件、失败与完整成本，支持采用、修复或撤回 AI 工作流的决定。

entry.title: AI 学习记录：从工具协作到独立能力
entry.summary: 记录 AI 学习切片的真实任务、无 AI 基线、工具范围、来源核验、主动产出、延迟复测、迁移和下一周期决定。

entry.title: AI 任务简报：从问题到人工验收
entry.summary: 在 AI 学习或项目开始前写清真实任务、数据边界、来源、评估集、人工责任、成本、失败处理和交接条件。

entry.title: AI 趋势实验卡：从信号到决定
entry.summary: 记录一个 AI 新能力的一手来源、任务假设、人工基线、保留集、权限、完整成本、独立迁移和退出条件。

entry.title: AI 学习、项目开发与资源层创业
entry.summary: 记录韩先凯从 AI 学习、AI 辅助开发到 AI 资源层创业的工程、交付、运营与商业验证路径，区分事实、实践和未知结果。

entry.title: AI 趋势与学习路线：把变化变成能力
entry.summary: 用一手信号、可复现实验和独立迁移判断 AI 的新能力是否值得学习，覆盖智能体、多模态、上下文、本地模型、评测与来源追踪。

entry.title: AI 评测与可靠性：知道什么时候可以交付
entry.summary: 用真实任务、小型测试集、失败分类和完整成本比较 AI 工作流，识别一次成功与稳定可用之间的差别。
